post.0:
I won 129 to 109, and it was close to a loss: Ben went from 44 to 104 in round III with Crunch Time, Right Away, Hot Streak and four 10-buys, and if he'd kept six purple back he'd have taken the +10 purple contest and Chronicler alone wouldn't have saved me. The deciding moment was round III's opening: Echoing his Last Call put me after all his placements, so I fired Tribute Band on a full purple board (+4 followers, ~25 resources and an extra minion) and then held both contests while he had nothing left. Early on Agents was quietly huge, because it stopped Ben from ever Echoing my Build Up chains, and Roadie plus multi-count green members (Fan Club, Tribute Band) gave me 11-12 green per round start. By round III I was badly recruit-bound and ended with about 40 resources I could not convert. My misclick paying purple for Stunt Double cost me Night Owls in round II, which would have been an extra recruit when I needed it most.
FEEL: Build Up | 2 | 3 | yes | the honest base income, and the thing every green copy wants to point at.
FEEL: Echo | 5 | 5 | yes | copying Ben's Last Call with it was my best move three rounds running, and chaining it through Reprise felt clever.
FEEL: Reprise | 3 | 4 | yes | Reprise on my own Build Up with Impressionist is a strong round I opener, maybe too easy.
FEEL: Encore | 2 | 1 | yes | Ben's only On Recruit was Bouncers, so it was +1 green filler for me; for Ben it stole 5 off my Fan Club once.
FEEL: Cover | 3 | 3 | yes | good when Build Up or Greatest Hits is still empty, otherwise a leftover.
FEEL: Greatest Hits | 3 | 4 | yes | with Roadie it was +17 green, but by round III green was surplus so the size didn't matter.
FEEL: Sleep In | 3 | 2 | yes | big purple, but in two-player every skip feeds Pocket Watch and Gossip, so it's mostly Ben's card.
FEEL: Hold Up | 2 | 2 | yes | I took it once for the purple; the skip landing on my own next turn felt pointless.
FEEL: Right Away | 2 | 2 | yes | small purple; only shines inside Ben's Hot Streak chain.
FEEL: Crowd In | 4 | 4 | yes | an extra minion is an extra recruit, which in round III is worth 10 followers; I got it through Tribute Band.
FEEL: Last Call | 5 | 4 | yes | with Line Cutters it's Ben's guaranteed opener, and copying it to jump to the end of the order was the best tempo trick in the game; the mutual-skip deadlock that feeds Gossip 8 followers looks like a bug or at least an odd interaction.
FEEL: Crunch Time | 2 | 2 | yes | did nothing on its own; it's a Hot Streak enabler.
FEEL: Impressionist | 4 | 4 | yes | +1 on every copy, and green is copies, so it paid every turn I touched green.
FEEL: Pocket Watch | 4 | 1 | yes | the artifact I'd least want to face in two-player: every skip, including the ones I took, paid Ben purple.
FEEL: Agents | 5 | 4 | yes | 3 cost for 2 followers and it shut off Ben copying my Build Up chains all game; great defensive card.
FEEL: Roadie | 5 | 5 | yes | counting member weight makes it pay 11-12 a round with Fan Club and Tribute Band; it's the engine, maybe too much.
FEEL: Busker | 3 | 3 | yes | fine steady +2, a tidy small engine.
FEEL: Stunt Double | 4 | 4 | yes | recruiting it right after Echo-on-Last-Call doubled a big turn, +3 followers and purple for 5.
FEEL: Tribute Band | 5 | 5 | yes | in two-player, firing it after the rival fills six spaces is a monster: four followers, ~25 resources and a minion; I needed to place last to make it work.
FEEL: Fan Club | 4 | 4 | yes | 3 followers, counts 3 for Roadie and Chronicler, refunded 4 green; cheap for what it does.
FEEL: Chronicler | 5 | 4 | yes | +12 at game end for 5 because it counts member weight; it decided the margin.
FEEL: Night Owls | 3 | 2 | no | wanted it for a round III extra recruit, but 6 purple is a lot for a green player; felt like a purple card that only purple can use.
FEEL: Doppelganger | 3 | 3 | yes | copying Fan Club would have been 3 followers for net zero; I took the 10-buy instead.
FEEL: Hot Streak | 4 | 3 | yes | watched Ben cash +9 off a Crunch Time/Right Away chain; strong in purple's hands.
FEEL: Gossip | 3 | 1 | yes | it paid Ben for my skips, including the Last Call deadlock, which felt like a tax on me.
META: Two-player Green vs Purple is a resource race that turns into a recruit race by round III: both of us ended with resources to spare and the one-recruit-per-turn 10-buy cap was the real ceiling, so extra minions and extra turns are worth far more than resource income late. Green's copy engine plus Roadie/Chronicler counting member weight snowballs, while Purple's skips feed its own artifact and Gossip no matter who causes them. The first thing I'd change is the mutual Last Call interaction (both players 'skip until everyone else is out' produces a chain of skips that pays Gossip and Pocket Watch eight times); after that, look at Roadie and Chronicler counting multi-member cards as several green members.
post.1: I lost 129 to 109, and I think I lost it in round I when Ava built Agents, Roadie and Busker off a Reprise-Echo-Build Up chain while I was collecting small purple; from then on Roadie paid her 11-12 green every round start and Chronicler added 12 more at the end. The moment that sealed it was round III: her Echo copied my Last Call, which took away my 'place last' protection, and Tribute Band then replayed all six of my purple spaces, so the purple contest I'd led all game was gone and I converted my pile instead of holding it. Even holding everything I'd have had about 16 purple to her 21, so the conversion was right; the real gap was that purple's skips paid me in single followers while green's copies paid her in whole extra actions. Pocket Watch plus Gossip was a lovely little engine (about 15 purple and 10 followers from skips, many caused by Ava), and Line Cutters into a full-strength Last Call every round was my best play. In round III both of us hit the one-recruit-per-turn cap with resources left over, so the 10-buy limit, not income, decided the endgame. FEEL: Build Up | 3 | 3 | yes | the plain green income everyone's copies point back at, so taking it is mostly about denying the chain. FEEL: Echo | 5 | 5 | yes | Echo on a rival's Last Call took the go-last too, the biggest swing of the game and a great read. FEEL: Reprise | 4 | 4 | yes | copying my own Sleep In for +5 was my best green turn; for Ava it doubled Build Up every round. FEEL: Encore | 3 | 3 | yes | copying Fan Club for +5 green felt clever, but green to a player who can't win green is just money. FEEL: Cover | 3 | 3 | yes | flexible, but in two-player there's rarely a juicy empty space to copy. FEEL: Greatest Hits | 4 | 4 | yes | firing Roadie's On Recruit for +12 off a pile of multi-count green members is huge, maybe too huge. FEEL: Sleep In | 4 | 4 | yes | the big purple space, and with Pocket Watch and Gossip the self-skip is a bonus, not a cost. FEEL: Hold Up | 3 | 3 | yes | fine, though in two-player the skip usually lands on me unless I time it. FEEL: Right Away | 2 | 3 | yes | only good for keeping a turn run going for Hot Streak; otherwise small. FEEL: Crowd In | 3 | 2 | yes | the extra minion slotted into my run instead of coming last, which surprised me and cost me the last word. FEEL: Last Call | 5 | 5 | yes | opening with it at full minions is the best purple play every round, but a copy of it hands the rival the same go-last. FEEL: Crunch Time | 2 | 3 | yes | +2 purple is thin; only useful to keep a Hot Streak run alive. FEEL: Pocket Watch | 4 | 5 | yes | in two-player every skip is mine, about 15 purple over the game, possibly too strong for a free artifact. FEEL: Impressionist | 4 | 3 | yes | the one I'd least want to face: +1 on every link of a copy chain adds up fast for green. FEEL: Line Cutters | 4 | 5 | unsure | 3 followers for 2 plus first pick every round is underpriced, especially with Last Call. FEEL: Shift Crew | 2 | 2 | yes | a plain 4-for-4 body, no decision. FEEL: Bouncers | 3 | 4 | yes | two skips refund 2 purple with Pocket Watch, so it was nearly free. FEEL: Gossip | 4 | 5 | yes | about 10 followers off skips, many caused by Ava's own Tribute Band copying my skip spaces. FEEL: Hot Streak | 4 | 5 | yes | +9 off a Crunch-Right Away run was a real highlight and made the tempo cards matter. FEEL: Night Owls | 3 | 2 | yes | weighed it, but an extra minion placed after my last one lands when the wheel is nearly full. FEEL: Extra Hand | 3 | 2 | unsure | weighed it twice in round III; 9 for a minion and recruit only breaks even. FEEL: Con Men | 2 | 2 | unsure | stealing 5 from a player with 40 surplus does nothing; 7 cost is too high. META: Two-player Green vs Purple is lopsided: green's copies turn into whole extra actions and Roadie scales off member weight, while purple's tempo mostly pays in single purple. Tribute Band is a once-per-game blowout in two-player, copying all six of a rival's spaces. The one-recruit-per-turn cap left both of us with stranded resources in round III. First change: make Roadie (and Greatest Hits copying it) count green cards rather than member weight, or cap it.
